limitations: Finite functional checks, not a throughput certification or 24-hour soak.

The broader live spot cohort hit analytical_queue_overflow during interrupted/long-running browser capture attempts; retained rows lost bars and summary, and explicit reselect recovered. Later capture attempts also hit this existing fail-closed boundary. No queue, cohort, depth or history budget was raised.

The managed tab initially auto-froze between turns; subsequent interaction checks used a persistent tab and interval-based waits. A source-picker attempt after reload raced catalog initialization; it was resumed after native options were present.
Owner-busy/last-completed-presentation and venue stale/continuity warnings remain visible. An eligible DOM response is not a guarantee of uninterrupted venue-global readiness.
Native API responses, DOM readouts and PNG captures are sequential observations, not an atomic multi-panel snapshot; each retained payload keeps its own identity/asof.
Hyperliquid remains a bounded 20-level snapshot feed with an unknown native price tick; missing historical intervals remain hatched.

harness.native_capture: async(file)=>ladderTab.run(async({page},path)=>{const response=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith('/api/v1/visualization')&&r.ok()&&JSON.parse(r.request().postData()||'{}').recenter===true,{timeout:30000});await page.click('[data-testid="view-recenter"]');const result=await response,request=JSON.parse(result.request().postData()),grid=await result.json();await page.waitForFunction(id=>document.querySelector('[data-testid="market-charts"]')?.getAttribute('data-painted-view-id')===id,{timeout:30000},grid.view_id);await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('.dom-status')?.textContent.includes('Ready')&&document.querySelectorAll('.dom-best').length===2,{timeout:30000});const evidence=await page.evaluate(async id=>{const frame=await(await fetch('/api/v1/sessions/'+id)).json();const ladder=JSON.parse(document.querySelector('.ladder-panel .evidence pre').textContent);const rect=document.querySelector('.ladder-scroll').getBoundingClientRect();return{frame,ladder,bar_cap:document.querySelector('.dom-scale .number').title,unit:document.querySelector('[aria-label="DOM quantity units"]').value,cumulative:document.querySelector('[aria-label="Cumulative depth"]').checked,both_best_visible:[...document.querySelectorAll('.dom-best')].every(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.top>=rect.top&&r.bottom<=rect.bottom;}),notices:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role="alert"],.dom-notice')].map(e=>e.textContent)};},request.session_id);if(evidence.frame.status!=='live'||!evidence.ladder.eligible||!evidence.both_best_visible)throw Error('Native depth is not live, eligible and centered');await page.screenshot({path,fullPage:true});return{...evidence,grid,request,screenshot:path};},{args:[evRoot+file],timeout:110})
